entities.name: GraphRAG
entities.description: A method for retrieval-augmented generation that uses community summaries and graphs, evaluated for comprehensiveness, diversity, and token efficiency.

entities.name: Podcast dataset
entities.description: A dataset containing podcast transcripts used to evaluate GraphRAG performance.

entities.name: News dataset
entities.description: A dataset containing news articles used to evaluate GraphRAG performance.

entities.name: Comprehensiveness
entities.description: A metric measuring the completeness of answers, reported as win rates.

entities.name: Diversity
entities.description: A metric measuring the variety of answers, reported as win rates.

entities.name: Context Tokens
entities.description: A metric measuring the number of tokens required for context, used to evaluate scalability and efficiency.

entities.name: Vector RAG
entities.description: A baseline retrieval-augmented generation method using vector similarity, compared against GraphRAG.

entities.name: Iterative Question Answering
entities.description: A task characterized by sensemaking activity, for which root-level GraphRAG is described as highly efficient.

relationships.description: GraphRAG was evaluated on the Podcast dataset.
